entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker who leads an undead panther warrior army, kills Belzenlok with the Blackblade, and is then claimed by Nicol Bolas through her pact.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights in the Cabal's pit, retrieves the Blackblade, and duels Belzenlok.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker who frees prisoners and burns through the Cabal's guards using skills she learned from Jaya.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: The Weatherlight's captain who leads the assault on the Stronghold and arranges to keep her crew together.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A legendary pyromancer who fights aboard the Weatherlight and joins the effort against Bolas.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time mage and planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch oath and the effort against Bolas.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A metal being who fights Urgoros and agrees to join the fight against Bolas without taking the oath.

entities.name: Raff
entities.description: A crew member and illusionist who composed a satirical Rite to Belzenlok.

entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: A magic-resistant warrior of the Weatherlight's crew.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A vampire crew member whose armor is melted by acid but who heals quickly.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: An angel and pilot of the Weatherlight who joins the fight against Urgoros and agrees to keep working with Jhoira.

entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: A thallid who calls the spirits and the corrupted elemental Muldrotha to save the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: A tall, gray-skinned warrior captured by the Cabal who fights in the pit and helps Gideon and Chandra.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The demon ruler of the Cabal who is drained and killed by the Blackblade wielded by Liliana.

entities.name: Whisper
entities.description: A Cabal cleric who tries to kill the pit prisoners and is killed by Radha's thrown knife.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: A giant living creature that grips the Weatherlight's bow until Muldrotha fights it.

entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: A corrupted elemental woven from rotting wood, corpses and mud, summoned by the spirits to fight Yargle.

entities.name: Urgoros
entities.description: A powerful lich that has never been human, riding a dragon-like beast, sent by Belzenlok against the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who is the broker of Liliana's pact and claims her contract when her demons die.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who waits on the new plane and declares that Liliana betrayed them.

entities.name: Josu
entities.description: Liliana's brother whom Belzenlok corrupted; his name is used in Liliana's final taunt.

entities.name: The Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship that attacks the Stronghold.

entities.name: The Blackblade
entities.description: A dark sword forged by Belzenlok to kill an elder dragon, used by Gideon and Liliana to drain Belzenlok's life.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact with Onakke spirits that Liliana cannot safely use yet.

entities.name: Mana-burner
entities.description: Explosive devices Jhoira constructed to attack the Stronghold.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A death cult led by Belzenlok that is crushed at the Stronghold.

entities.name: Panther warriors
entities.description: Undead warriors raised by Liliana from an old massacre site.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance of planeswalkers for whom Gideon gives Teferi the oath.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: An organization with which Jhoira's crew made a bargain to eradicate the Cabal.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: The artifact powering the Weatherlight that Tiana may deliver to the Church.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: The Cabal's volcano fortress with a fighting pit, treasure vaults and curtain walls.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The swampy region where the Stronghold is located.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Where the Weatherlight will take Radha home.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest where the Weatherlight will take Slimefoot and its children.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: Where Raff extracted information from a Cabal agent and where the Cabal mocked an ode.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane Karn means to destroy.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who asked for help together with Jace.

events.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
events.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

events.summary: Liliana saves Jhoira from falling from the tilting deck.
events.quote: Liliana managed to wedge herself between the deck and the rail, gripping Jhoira's arm to keep her from falling.

events.summary: Jhoira's owl drops a mana-charged burner on Yargle, but it fails to dislodge the creature.
events.quote: Yargle still gripped the bow, and now its gigantic maw was opening.

events.summary: Gideon falls into the pit, kills a maddened attacker, and takes a sword while the prisoners fight under dementia magic.
events.quote: That was when he realized everyone attacking him was wild-eyed with dementia magic.

events.summary: Gideon joins a back-to-back group led by the warrior Radha.
events.quote: She thrust her sword through the chest of a black-robed cultist and said, "I'm Radha."

events.summary: Slimefoot asks the Urborg spirits for help and they promise to call something that can help.
events.quote: But we will call something that can .

events.summary: Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental, rises behind Yargle and seizes it.
events.quote: It's Muldrotha, a corrupted elemental!

events.summary: Muldrotha pries open Yargle's jaws and frees the Weatherlight, then bears Yargle down into the swamp.
events.quote: Muldrotha extruded a limb made of rotting wood and corpses into Yargle's clamped jaw and pried it open.

events.summary: Jhoira directs the ship to the Stronghold after Slimefoot's call for help succeeds.
events.quote: Jhoira agreed. It was time to end this. "To the Stronghold."

events.summary: Belzenlok leaves the arena to defend the Stronghold, and Chandra searches for a way to free Gideon.
events.quote: Then Belzenlok stood. His voice roared, "Defend the Stronghold!"

events.summary: Whisper begins to kill the pit prisoners with black mist, and Chandra attacks her and her guards with fire.
events.quote: Whisper was going to kill the rest of the prisoners in the pit.

events.summary: Chandra burns the chain lock on the stair mechanism and lowers the stairs so Gideon and the other prisoners can climb out.
events.quote: Chandra ran back to the stair mechanism, burned through the chain lock, and threw the lever.

events.summary: Radha throws a knife into Whisper's eye, killing her after Gideon's shield deflects her spell.
events.quote: Then suddenly a blade blossomed in Whisper's right eye.

events.summary: Radha agrees to help Gideon and Chandra after hearing the Weatherlight has been restored.
events.quote: "Then I'll come with you." Radha turned to the others.

events.summary: Teferi and Karn rejoin the ship as the Weatherlight attacks, and Teferi dissolves the first gate while Jhoira's owl blows up the next with a mana-burner.
events.quote: Teferi held out his hand and the gate across the causeway turned red with corrosion, then dissolved in a puff of rust.

events.summary: Urgoros rises from the volcano on a dragon-like mount to attack the Weatherlight.
events.quote: I think that's Urgoros!

events.summary: Chandra blasts open the treasury doors with fire.
events.quote: Her fire washed over it, white-hot, and burned away chains, the sigils powering the guard spells, and the door itself.

events.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
events.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

events.summary: Tiana deflects Urgoros's spear to save Liliana, and Jaya, Karn, Tiana and Arvad drive it off the ship.
events.quote: Tiana suddenly landed in front of her.

events.summary: Jhoira realizes Urgoros is only a distraction, and the spirits build a tower of bodies to lower Liliana to the ground.
events.quote: They kept coming, the tower of spirit bodies rising higher and higher.

events.summary: Gideon, Chandra and Radha find the Blackblade in the fourth treasury vault and fight through the Stronghold's hall as the undead overwhelm the Cabal.
events.quote: They had found the weapon inside the fourth treasury vault, mounted on a stone plinth like a trophy.

events.summary: Gideon draws the Blackblade and confronts Belzenlok outside the Stronghold.
events.quote: Gideon took a deep breath and drew the Blackblade.

events.summary: Belzenlok recognizes Gideon as a planeswalker of the Gatewatch and says he knows what is planned for them.
events.quote: You. The Gatewatch. I know what's planned for you.

events.summary: Liliana taunts Belzenlok about her brother and the pact signers she has killed to draw him away from Gideon.
events.quote: You should have left my brother alone.

events.summary: Belzenlok knocks Gideon down, but the Blackblade pierces his thigh and Liliana grabs the hilt.
events.quote: Liliana leapt forward, under Belzenlok's arm, and seized the Blackblade's hilt.

events.summary: Liliana drains Belzenlok's life with the Blackblade and kills him; his body collapses into lumps of flesh.
events.quote: What was left of Belzenlok collapsed into lumps of white flesh.

events.summary: Liliana finds the lines of her pact are still on her skin after Belzenlok's death.
events.quote: but the lines of her pact were still written on her skin.

events.summary: Jhoira and Tiana keep their crew together by deciding the bargain with the Church of Serra requires eradicating the Cabal from all of Dominaria.
events.quote: I thought it was to eradicate the Cabal from all of Dominaria.

events.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
events.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

events.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

events.summary: Bolas reveals that Liliana's pact defaults to its broker, himself, when her demons die, and he threatens that disobedience will kill her.
events.quote: You seem unaware that with your demons dead, your contract defaults to its broker.

events.summary: Bolas planeswalks away and Liliana follows, resolved to find an escape while staying alive.
events.quote: Sick at heart, bound like a prisoner to a new incarnation of a fate she had schemed so long to cheat, Liliana followed in his wake.

events.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
events.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

events.summary: Gideon returns to the empty Stronghold court, finds Liliana's aether trail leading away from the others, and leaves Dominaria.
events.quote: She had left Dominaria, but she hadn't followed him and the others.

relations.note: she drains his life with the Blackblade
relations.quote: It had been a pleasure to kill all her demons, but destroying Belzenlok in this way was a particular delight.

relations.note: Belzenlok claims he forged it to kill an elder dragon
relations.quote: I forged it to kill an elder dragon.

relations.note: Gideon calls them his deluded cultists; the Cabal fights in his name
relations.quote: do you actually believe these lies you spout to your deluded cultists

relations.note: she throws the knife that kills the cleric
relations.quote: She hung onto the edge of the pit with one hand and had thrown the knife with the other.
Muldrotha pried at Yargle's jaws with its hands, and its weight bore the creature down into the muddy swamp.

relations.note: broker of her pact, which now controls her
relations.quote: your contract defaults to its broker.
he wouldn't have sent this thing against us if I could take control of it.

relations.note: Jhoira wants to keep her crew together
relations.quote: But Jhoira didn't want to break up their crew.

relations.note: they fight together in the pit and in the Stronghold
Gideon administers the Gatewatch oath to Teferi
relations.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

relations.note: Jace distrusts her and believes she used them
relations.quote: I told you, she can't be trusted.
She turned to Karn, and hugged him too, despite the hard edges of his metal body.
